people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

translations.web: Moab will be destroyed from being a people, because he has magnified himself against Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Moab will be destroyed as a nation because he vaunted himself against the LORD.
translations.kjv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against the LORD.
translations.asv: And Moab shall be destroyed from being a people, because he hath magnified himself against Jehovah.
